spans.s:
भष्^1 {c1c} P. (भष्ति)
1 To bark,
growl, bark at.
--2 To abuse,
reproach, revile, rail at.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170214. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/336. note: verb missing virama.

भस्^1 {vI.v} {c3c} P. (बभस्ति)
1 To shine.
--2 To revile, blame, abuse. {vII.v} {c1c} P.
(भसति) To eat.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170214. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/336. note: omission in print.

भाष् {c1c} A. (भाषते, भाषित)
1 To
say, speak, utter; त्वयैकमीशं प्रति
साधु भाषितं

; oft. with two
acc.; भीतां प्रियामेत्य वचो बभाषे

.
--2 To speak to,
address; किंचिद्विहस्यार्थपतिं बभाषे

; 3. 51.
--3 To tell, announce,
declare; क्षितिपालमुच्चैः प्रीत्या
तमेवार्थमभाषतेव

.
--4 To speak or
talk about.
--5 To name, call.
--6 To
describe. --WITH अनु {1} to speak,
say. {2} to communicate, announce;

भास् {c1c} A. (भासते, भासित)
1 To
shine, glitter, be bright;
तावत्कामनृपातपत्रसुषमं बिंबं बभासे विधोः

.
--2 To become clear or evident,
come into the mind; त्वदंगमार्दवे दृष्टं
कस्य चित्ते न भासते ।
मालतीशशभृल्लेखाकदलीनां कठोरता

.
--3 To appear. --Caus. (भासयति-ते)
1 To brighten, irradiate, illuminate;
अधिवसंस्तनुमध्वरदीक्षितामसमभासमभासयदीश्वरः

.
--2
To show, make clear or evident,
manifest;

भास् f. [भास्-भावे क्विप्]
1 Light,
lustre, brightness; दृशा
निशेंदीवरचारुभासा

; 4. 16.
--3
A reflection, an image.
--4 Majesty,
glory, splendour.
--5 Wish, desire.
--Comp.
--करः {1} the sun;
Śi. 11. 49;

.
{2} a hero. {3} fire. {4} an epithet
of Śiva. {5} N. of a celebrated
Hindu astronomer who is said to
have flourished in the eleventh or
twelfth century A. D.
--(रं) gold.
˚द्युतिः N: of Viṣṇu. ˚प्रियः a ruby.
˚सप्तमी the seventh day in the
bright half of Māgha.
--करिः the
planet Saturn.

भासः [भास्-भावे घञ्]
1
Brightness, light, lustre.
--2 Fancy.
--3 A
[]
cock.
--4 A vulture.
--5 A
cowshed (गोष्ठ).
--6 N. of a poet;
भासो हासः कविकुलगुरुः कालिदासो
विलासः P.

भषणः A dog.
--णं The barking
of a dog, a growl.

]
1 The
sun.
--2 Flesh.
--3 A kind of duck.
--4 Time.
--5 A float (प्लव).
--6 The
hinder parts (said to be f. and n.
also).
--7 Pudendum muliebre.
--8
A month.

भाषित p. p. [भाष्-कर्मणि-क्त]
Spoken, said, uttered.
--तं Speech,
utterance words, language;
[]

भस्त्रका, --भस्त्रा, --भस्त्रिः f. [भस्-ष्टन्]
1 A bellows.
--2 A leathern vessel
for holding water.
--3 A pouch,
leathern bag.

भस्त्रका, --भस्त्रा, --भस्त्रिः f. [भस्-ष्टन्]
1 A bellows.
--2 A leathern vessel
for holding water.
--3 A pouch,
leathern bag.

भस्त्रका, --भस्त्रा, --भस्त्रिः f. [भस्-ष्टन्]
1 A bellows.
--2 A leathern vessel
for holding water.
--3 A pouch,
leathern bag.

1 Gold or silver.
--2
Morbid appetite from over-digestion of
food.
--3 A kind of disease of the
eyes.

.
--2 Sacred ashes (smeared on
the body); (स्मनि हु ‘to sacrifice
in ashes’, i. e. to do a useless
work).
--Comp.
--अग्निः morbid
[]
appetite from rapid digestion of food.
--अवशेष a. remaining in the form
of ashes; भस्मावशेषं मदनं चकार

; Ś. 3. 2.
--आह्वयः camphor.
--उद्धूलनं, --गुंठनं smearing the body
with ashes; भस्मोद्धूलन भद्रपस्तु भवते
K.

.
--कारः a washerman.
--कूटः a heap of ashes.
--गंधा,
गंधिका, -गंधिनी a kind of perfume.
--तूलं
{1} frost, snow. {2} a shower of dust.
{3} a number of villages.
--प्रियः an
epithet of Śiva.
--भूत a. dead.
--मेहः
a sort of gravel.
--रोगः a kind of
disease; cf. भस्माग्नि.
--लेपनं smearing
the body with ashes.
--विधिः any
rite performed with ashes.
--वेधकः
camphor.
--शायिन् m. N. of Śiva.
--स्नानं purification by ashes.

भस्मसात्^1 ind. To the state of
ashes; ˚कृ ‘to reduce to ashes.’ ˚भू
to be reduced to ashes.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,.

भस्मा(स्मी)कृ {c8c} U. To reduce to
ashes.

भस्मा(स्मी)कृ {c8c} U. To reduce to
ashes.

1 Reducing to ashes.
--2
Completely consuming or burning.
--3 Calcining.

भस्मीकृत a.
1 Reduced to ashes.
--2 Caleined (as a metal).

भस्मीभू {c1c} P. To be reduced to
ashes; भस्मीभूतस्य देहस्य पुनरागमनं
कतः Sarva. S.

भाषक a. [भाष्-ण्वुल्] (At the end
of comp.) Speaking, talking about.

भासक a. (सिका f.) [भास्-ण्वुल्]
1 Enlightening, brightening,
illuminating.
--2 Showing, making
evident.
--3 Making intelligible.
--कः N. of a poet.

भाषणं [भाष्-भावे ल्युट्]
1 Speaking,
talking, saying.
--2 Speech, words,
talk.
--3 Kind words.

भाषा [भास्-अ]
1 Speech, talk; as
in चारुभाषः.
--2 Language, tongue;

.
--3 A common or
vernacular dialect; (a) the spoken
Sanskrit language (opp छंदस् or
वेद); विभाषा भाषायां

.
--5 An epithet of Sarasvatī,
the goddess of speech.
--6 (In law)
The first of the four stages of a
law-suit; the plaint, charge or
accusation.
--Comp.
--अंतरं {1} another
dialect or language. {2} translation
(?).
--पादः a charge, plaint; see भाषां
(6) above.
--समः a figure of speech,
which consists in so arranging the
words of a sentence that it may be
considered and read either as
Sanskrit or Prākṛta (one or more of
its varieties); e. g. मंजुलमणिमंजीरे
कलगंभीरे विहारसरसीतीरे । विरसासि केलिकीरे
किमालि धीरे च गंधसारसमीरे ॥ S.

(एष श्लोकः
संस्कृतप्राकृतशौरसेनीप्राच्यावंतीनागरापभ्रंशेष्वेकविध एव); किं त्वां भणामि
विच्छेददारुणायासकारिणि । कामं कुरु वरारोहे
देहि मे परिरंभणं

(which
is in Sanskrit or Śaurasenī); so
6. 10.

भास Mentioned by Bāṇa and Kālidāsa as their
predecessor. Flourished before the 7th century.

भाषिक a. Belonging to common
or vernacular speech.

भाषिन् a.
1 (At the end of comp.)
Speaking, talking; as in अल्प˚ &c.
--2 Loquacious, talkative.

भाष्यं [भाष्-ण्यत्]
1 Speaking,
talking.
--2 Any work in the
common or vernacular language.
--3
Exposition, gloss, commentary; as
in वेदभाष्य.
--4 Especially, a
commentary which explains Sūtras or
aphorisms word by word with
comments of its own; (सूत्रार्थो वर्ण्यते यत्र
पदैः सूत्रानुसारिभिः । स्वपदानि च वर्ण्यंते भाष्यं
भाष्यविदो विदुः ॥); संक्षिप्तस्याप्यतोऽस्यैव
वाक्यस्यार्थगरीयसः । सुविस्तरतरा वाचो
भाष्यभूता भवंतु मे Śi. 2. 24;
फणिभाषितभाष्यफक्किका

.
--5 N.
of the great commentary of
Patanjali on Pāṇini's Sūtras.
--6 A
sort of house.
--Comp.
--करः,
--कारः, --कृत् m. {1} a commentator,
scholiast. {2} N. of Patañjali.

भासंत a. (ती f.)
1 Shining.
--2
Beautiful, handsome.
--तः
1 The
sun.
--2 The moon.
--3 An asterism,
a star.
--4 The bird भास q. v.
--ती
An asterism (नक्षत्र).

भास्वत् a. Bright, shining,
luminous, resplendent;

.
--2 Light, lustre, splendour.
--3 A hero.
--4 Ved. Dawn.
--ती
The city of the sun.

भास्वर a. [भास्-वरच्] Shining,
bright, radiant, brilliant.
--रः
1
The sun.
--2 A day.
--3 Fire.

भास्मन a. (नी f.) [भस्मनो
विकारोऽण्] Consisting or made of ashes,
ashy; Śi. 4. 65.
